source: Alpaca SIP split via project GET-only CLI
portfolio: Two independently compounded sleeves, initial 50/50, no periodic rebalance, weights drift. No leverage. Each sleeve limited to own cash. Periods restart capital; full-period diagnostic separate.

rules.MOM252: At actual month-end completed daily close: close>close.shift(252) means long, else cash. Act next session open. No intraday protective stop; backtest only. Insufficient warmup means remain cash, not synthetic history.
rules.BREAKOUT55: Enter next open if completed close > max previous55 closes; exit next open if close<min previous20 closes. No same-bar signal fills, no intraday stop.
rules.ORB30: Regular NY session only; first30min high/low. First completed5min close>range high with signal before noon, next5min open. Stop range low, gap fill adverse open, stop may trigger entry bar; risk0.5% sleeve equity capped sleeve cash. One trade/day/symbol. Exit open of final regular5min bar. Incomplete sessions skipped. Earlyclose via session_end.

friction: Per side 2.5bps plus $0.01/share; cost multiplier on friction. Fee scenario adds max($1.375,5bps notional) per side. This is scenario, not complete IBKR tariff; external exchange fees excluded.
selection: Rank baseline strategies on WF daily net Sharpe descending if return>0, max drawdown<=25%, roundtrips>=10. If none eligible: no winner, top WF Sharpe research candidate only. Save selection before HO execution. No change to winner after HO.
sensitivity: Joint parameter scaling .8/1.2: MOM202/302, breakout44/16 and66/24, ORB25/35min due5min granularity. Diagnostic only, not individual parameter robustness proof.
holdout: Retrospective fixed-rule research; data downloaded but not used for ranking. HO processed after selection persisted. No universal unseen-data guarantee.
trial_unit: one strategy parameter/cost/capital configuration, both symbols jointly; all planned configs logged before execution, including diagnostic runs
